name: Lollipop Factory
original_name: ロリポップファクトリー
source:
Haruki is the owner of the import candy shop “Lollipop Factory”, which used to be a dagashi-ya shop run by his late grandmother. Now it’s a cute and colourful candy shop which is popular among the students at the nearby girls’ school. One day, five girls from the nearby Kotohana girls’ school came to gain work experience. He becomes close to them through sweets and soon forms a relationship with them!?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/06/06/june-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
春树是进口糖果店“棒棒糖工厂”的店主。这家店过去是已故祖母经营的粗点心店，如今成了附近女子学校学生们喜欢的可爱多彩糖果店。一天，附近琴花女子学校的五名女孩来这里体验工作。他通过糖果与她们熟悉起来，很快就和她们建立了关系！？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/06/06/june-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
